PARTICIPATING PROVIDER AGREEMENT

This Participating Provider Agreement is entered into as of June 1, 2026 between Cardinal Ridge Health Plan, Inc., an Ohio health insuring corporation ("Plan"), and Willowbrook Family Medicine LLC, an Ohio limited liability company ("Provider").

1. Participation. "Covered Services" means those health care services and supplies that are listed as benefits in a Member's evidence of coverage, are medically necessary, and are rendered by Provider within the scope of Provider's licensure. Provider shall render Covered Services to Members enrolled in the Plan's commercial and Medicare Advantage products listed in Exhibit A. Provider shall not discriminate against a Member on the basis of the Member's source of payment, health status, or the Member's exercise of any right under the plan.

2. Credentialing. Provider and each of its practitioners shall be credentialed and recredentialed under the Plan's credentialing policy, which meets NCQA standards, before rendering Covered Services and at least every thirty-six (36) months thereafter. Provider shall notify Plan within five (5) business days of any change in licensure, DEA registration, malpractice coverage, or exclusion status.

3. Compensation. Plan shall pay Provider the rates in Exhibit B, which is the Plan's fee schedule. Rates may be amended on ninety (90) days' prior written notice to Provider, and Provider may terminate under Section 9 if it does not accept the amended rates.

4. Claims and Prompt Payment. Provider shall submit clean claims within ninety (90) days of the date of service. Plan shall pay or deny a clean claim within thirty (30) days of receipt for electronic claims and forty-five (45) days for paper claims, with interest on late payment as required by Ohio Revised Code Section 3901.381.

5. Hold Harmless. Provider shall look solely to Plan for compensation for Covered Services and shall not bill, charge, or seek compensation, remuneration, or reimbursement from a Member, or maintain any action against a Member, for Covered Services, except for applicable copayments, coinsurance, and deductibles. This provision survives termination of this Agreement, including insolvency of the Plan, and is for the benefit of Members.

6. Utilization Management and Appeals. Provider shall cooperate with the Plan's utilization management program. An adverse determination may be appealed under the Plan's appeals policy, and Provider may request an expedited appeal and an external review where applicable law provides one. Nothing in this Agreement prohibits Provider from discussing treatment options with a Member, including options not covered by the Plan, or from advocating on the Member's behalf.

7. Medical Records and HIPAA. Provider shall maintain Member medical records for at least ten (10) years and shall make them available to Plan for quality review, audit, and regulatory purposes. The parties shall comply with HIPAA, and Provider's use and disclosure of protected health information is governed by the Business Associate Agreement attached as Exhibit C.

8. Insurance. Provider shall maintain professional liability insurance of at least $1,000,000 per occurrence and $3,000,000 in the aggregate, and shall give Plan thirty (30) days' notice of cancellation.

9. Term and Termination. The initial term is one (1) year, renewing annually. Either party may terminate without cause on ninety (90) days' written notice, and Plan may terminate immediately for Provider's loss of licensure, exclusion from a federal health care program, or conduct posing an imminent risk to Members.

10. Continuity of Care. On termination, Provider shall continue to render Covered Services to a Member in an active course of treatment, at the contracted rates, for ninety (90) days, or through the postpartum period for a Member in her second or third trimester, as required by Ohio law.

11. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Ohio.

CARDINAL RIDGE HEALTH PLAN, INC.  By: /s/ Marguerite Delacroix-Nwosu, VP Network
WILLOWBROOK FAMILY MEDICINE LLC   By: /s/ Ezekiel Tanaka-Boateng, MD, Managing Member
